content.json:
## Film Library
Requests, age-restricted views, dependencies and errors for the React app (`FilmLibrary.Web`) and the API (`FilmLibrary.Api`). For a single request end to end, open **Transaction search** or **Failures** in Application Insights and select an operation.

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: API requests and failures (5xx)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'filmlibrary.film.views'
| extend Outcome = tostring(customDimensions['outcome']), Rating = tostring(customDimensions['film.rating'])
| summarize Views = sum(valueSum) by Rating, Outcome
| order by Rating asc
content.title: Film views by rating and outcome (age_restricted = refused for age)

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), P50ms = round(percentile(duration, 50)), P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by Operation = operation_Name
| order by Requests desc
content.title: API operations

content.query:
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName == 'FilmLibrary.Api'
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by Type = type, Target = target, Name = name
| order by Calls desc
| take 20
content.title: API dependencies (Cosmos DB, sign-in provider metadata)

content.query:
pageViews
| summarize PageViews = count(), AvgLoadMs = round(avg(duration)) by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Browser page views and load time

content.query:
dependencies
| where cloud_RoleName == 'FilmLibrary.Web'
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), P95ms = round(percentile(duration, 95)) by Target = target, Name = name, ResultCode = resultCode
| order by Calls desc
| take 20
content.title: Calls from the browser (as users experienced them)

content.query:
exceptions
| summarize Count = count(), LastSeen = max(timestamp) by Role = cloud_RoleName, Type = type, Message = outermostMessage
| order by LastSeen desc
content.title: Exceptions (browser and API)
